records.jp: 何置く？
records.en_original: What should we put in here?
records.en: What should we put in here?

records.jp: 物置なんだし、普段あまり使わないものを<CR>置けばいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: It's for storage, so why don't we keep the stuff we don't really use in it?
records.en: It's for storage, so why don't we keep the stuff we don't really use in it?

records.jp: それはそうなんだけどさ、もったいなくない？
records.en_original: That's true, but isn't it kind of a waste of space?
records.en: That's true, but isn't it kind of a waste of space?

records.jp: もったいない？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: だってこんなに広くておっきいんだよ
records.en_original: It's so big and wide.
records.en: It's so big and wide.

records.jp: 配置とかにこだわってさ、<CR>第二の秘密基地にしても面白いと思うんだ
records.en_original: We could turn it into a second secret base! And set it up just the way we want.
records.en: We could turn it into a second secret base! And set it up just the way we want.

records.jp: まぁ、確かにちょうどいい大きさではあると思うけど。<CR>たとえばどんな風にしたいとかあるの？
records.en_original: Yeah, it is just the right size... What would you want to turn it into?
records.en: Yeah, it is just the right size... What would you want to turn it into?

records.jp: そりゃやっぱ、遊び部屋でしょ
records.en_original: Definitely a rec room.
records.en: Definitely a rec room.

records.jp: 好きなお菓子いっぱい並べて、<CR>ゲームできるスペースも作って
records.en_original: It'd have all kinds of sweets, and a space for games.
records.en: It'd have all kinds of sweets, and a space for games.

records.jp: なんかそれ、駄菓子屋みたいだね
records.en_original: That sounds like an old-fashioned candy store.
records.en: That sounds like an old-fashioned candy store.

records.jp: あ、あり！　駄菓子屋作っちゃおう
records.en_original: Oh! Good idea! Let's make it a candy store!
records.en: Oh! Good idea! Let's make it a candy store!

records.jp: 放課後駄菓子屋に寄るとか、<CR>ちょっと憧れだったんだよね
records.en_original: I've always wanted to be able to swing by a candy store after school.
records.en: I've always wanted to be able to swing by a candy store after school.

records.jp: だったらなおさら作んなきゃじゃん。<CR>日菜子さんの憧れ、叶えるぞー！
records.en_original: We have to do it then! We can make your dream come true, Hinako!
records.en: We have to do it then! We can make your dream come true, Hinako-san!

records.jp: ぱ、パウダールームとか
records.en_original: How about a powder room?
records.en: How about a powder room?

records.jp: パウダールームって、たまに駅とかデパートのトイレに<CR>ついてる、メイク直しするところ？
records.en_original: A place to fix your makeup? Like the ones by the restrooms at train stations and department stores?
records.en: A place to fix your makeup? Like the ones by the restrooms at train stations and department stores?

records.jp: そうそう。ああいうの憧れない？<CR>女優ミラーがバーンって並んでるの
records.en_original: Yeah! Haven't you ever wanted one? To do your makeup sitting in front of a big vanity mirror?
records.en: Yeah! Haven't you ever wanted one? To do your makeup sitting in front of a big vanity mirror?

records.jp: で、一席一席コンセントがついてて、<CR>コットンとかアメニティが置いてあるの
records.en_original: Each seat would have an electrical outlet, cotton swabs, and other amenities.
records.en: Each seat would have an electrical outlet, cotton swabs, and other amenities.

records.jp: 確かに更衣室の鏡でもいいんだけど、朝は混むし、<CR>トイレの鏡だと落ち着かないもんね
records.en_original: Sounds nice. The mirror in the changing room is fine, but it's so crowded in the mornings. And you can't really relax while using the bathroom mirror.
records.en: Sounds nice. The mirror in the changing room is fine, but it's so crowded in the mornings. And you can't really relax while using the bathroom mirror.

records.jp: バレエやってた時も、そういう楽屋の方が<CR>メイクしやすかった気がする
records.en_original: It was definitely easier to do makeup in the green room when I used to do ballet.
records.en: It was definitely easier to do makeup in the green room when I used to do ballet.

records.jp: あー、楽屋ってコンセプトいいね！<CR>レイアウトお任せしちゃおうかな
records.en_original: Ooh, a green room! That's a great concept! I'll leave the layout to you!
records.en: Ooh, a green room! That's a great concept! I'll leave the layout to you!

records.jp: えー、できるかなぁ
records.en_original: Really? I don't know if I'm up to that...
records.en: Really? I don't know if I'm up to that...

records.jp: まぁ、まずは校内に置ききれない物優先だけど。<CR>あくまで物置きとして作ったんだから
records.en_original: Well, the priority should be to store things we can't keep in the school. It's a storage space, after all.
records.en: Well, the priority should be to store things we can't keep in the school. It's a storage space, after all.

records.jp: はーい
records.en_original: Fine...
records.en: Fine...

records.jp: でもそう考えると、ちょうどこのくらいなのかも
records.en_original: But, when it comes down to it, this might be all you need.
records.en: But, when it comes down to it, this might be all you need.

records.jp: 何が？
records.en_original: For what?
records.en: For what?

records.jp: 一人暮らしの部屋
records.en_original: For a one-room apartment.
records.en: For a one-room apartment.

records.jp: あー、そうかも。ちょっと長細いけど
records.en_original: Oh, maybe. It's a bit long and narrow, though.
records.en: Oh, maybe. It's a bit long and narrow, though.

records.jp: バレエやってた頃、色んなところの先生に習いに<CR>行ってたんだけど
records.en_original: When I did ballet, I used to go all over learning from different teachers.
records.en: When I did ballet, I used to go all over learning from different teachers.

records.jp: すごくいいなって思う先生がいて、長期的に習うために<CR>アパート借りようか考えたことがあったんだ
records.en_original: There was one teacher that was really good. I thought about renting an apartment nearby so I could continue learning from them.
records.en: There was one teacher that was really good. I thought about renting an apartment nearby so I could continue learning from them.

records.jp: えー！？　それって、中学生とか小学生の頃でしょ？
records.en_original: What?! This was when you were in elementary or middle school?
records.en: What?! This was when you were in elementary or middle school?

records.jp: そう。結局その話は流れちゃったけど
records.en_original: Yeah. I never went through with it, though.
records.en: Yeah. I never went through with it, though.

records.jp: でも未だに一人暮らしにはちょっと憧れたり<CR>するんだよね。愛央はどう？
records.en_original: But I've still always wanted to try living alone. How about you, Ao?
records.en: But I've still always wanted to try living alone. How about you, Ao?

records.jp: 憧れる。誰からも怒られない環境で一日中<CR>だらだらしたい
records.en_original: Totally. I wanna be able to lay around all day without getting yelled at.
records.en: Totally. I wanna be able to lay around all day without getting yelled at.

records.jp: 別に怒られててもだらだらしてるでしょ
records.en_original: You just lay around all day even if you do get yelled at.
records.en: You just lay around all day even if you do get yelled at.

records.jp: あらひどい。私だって怒られるたびに傷ついてるんだよ
records.en_original: That's so mean! I feel hurt every time I get yelled at, you know.
records.en: That's so mean! I feel hurt every time I get yelled at, you know.

records.jp: えっ……そうなの？<CR>もしかして私、言い方きつい時あった？
records.en_original: Oh... Really? Have I ever been too harsh?
records.en: Oh... Really? Have I ever been too harsh?

records.jp: ……いや、だったら繰り返さないか
records.en_original: ...No, you wouldn't keep doing it if I was.
records.en: ...No, you wouldn't keep doing it if I was.

records.jp: えへへ、バレちゃった
records.en_original: Hehehe, exactly.
records.en: Hehehe, exactly.

records.jp: 実家の方がいいかな
records.en_original: I think I'd rather live at home.
records.en: I think I'd rather live at home.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: Why's that?
records.en: Why's that?

records.jp: ご飯も掃除も洗濯も全部やってもらえるから
records.en_original: I don't have to cook, or clean, or do laundry.
records.en: I don't have to cook, or clean, or do laundry.

records.jp: あはは、愛央らしい
records.en_original: Haha, I knew you'd say something like that.
records.en: Haha, I knew you'd say something like that.

records.jp: それに、ずっと一人だと……飽きちゃうかなって
records.en_original: And I'd probably get bored being alone all the time...
records.en: And I'd probably get bored being alone all the time...

records.jp: 今はこうやって話したい時に日菜子さんとかと<CR>話せるけど、一人暮らしだとそうはいかないじゃん
records.en_original: I can talk to you or the others whenever I want to now, but I wouldn't be able to if I lived alone.
records.en: Right now, I can talk to you, Hinako-san, or anyone else whenever I feel like it, but I couldn't do that if I lived alone.

records.jp: じゃあ、シェアハウスとかなら向いてるかもね
records.en_original: Hmm, you might be better off living with roommates, then.
records.en: Hmm, you might be better off living with roommates, then.

records.jp: あー、そうかも！
records.en_original: Yeah, you're right!
records.en: Yeah, you're right!

records.jp: 日菜子さん、元の世界でまた会えたら、<CR>同棲しようよ！　同棲！
records.en_original: Hey Hinako, if we meet again in our world, let's live together! We can be domestic partners!
records.en: Hey Hinako-san, if we meet again in our world, let's live together! We can be domestic partners!

records.jp: シェアハウスね！　その言い方は語弊があるから！
records.en_original: Umm, I think you mean roommates?
records.en: Umm, I think you mean roommates?

records.jp: でも一人暮らしするなら部屋をこうしたい、<CR>みたいなのは一応あるよ
records.en_original: But if I ever lived alone, I know what kind of place I'd want.
records.en: But if I ever lived alone, I know what kind of place I'd want.

records.jp: へぇ、どんなの？
records.en_original: Really? Tell me all about it.
records.en: Really? Tell me all about it.

records.jp: 大人っぽいシックな部屋かな。<CR>ガラステーブルとか置いてさぁ
records.en_original: Something chic and grown-up. Maybe with a glass table or something.
records.en: Something chic and grown-up. Maybe with a glass table or something.

records.jp: 合成でもいいから、革のソファとか<CR>間接照明も置けるといいよね
records.en_original: And a leather sofa, even if it's fake leather. Oh, and indirect lighting.
records.en: And a leather sofa, even if it's fake leather. Oh, and indirect lighting.

records.jp: この大きさで？
records.en_original: In a room this size?
records.en: In a room this size?

records.jp: ちょっと狭いか～
records.en_original: I guess it's a little too small...
records.en: I guess it's a little too small...

records.jp: でもわかるよ。そういう部屋、私も憧れる
records.en_original: But I know what you mean. I've always wanted to live somewhere like that too.
records.en: But I know what you mean. I've always wanted to live somewhere like that too.

records.jp: いつか住めるように、頑張ろう！
records.en_original: I'm sure we'll be able to live in that kind of place someday!
records.en: I'm sure we'll be able to live in that kind of place someday!

records.jp: そうだね……頑張ろう。何かを
records.en_original: Yeah... I hope you're right.
records.en: Yeah... I hope you're right.

records.jp: そりゃもう、ゴリゴリの趣味部屋にしたいよね
records.en_original: I'd want my place to be totally decked out.
records.en: I'd want my place to be totally decked out.

records.jp: ポスターとかタペストリー飾って、<CR>グッズ敷き詰めてさぁ
records.en_original: I'd hang all kinds of posters and tapestries on the walls, and fill every nook and cranny with merchandise from my favorite series.
records.en: I'd hang all kinds of posters and tapestries on the walls, and fill every nook and cranny with merchandise from my favorite series.

records.jp: ……あのさ
records.en_original: You know...
records.en: You know...

records.jp: なに？
records.en_original: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 愛央って普段、私をすごいバレエ好きみたいな<CR>扱いするけどさ
records.en_original: You always act like I'm obsessed with ballet, Ao.
records.en: You always act like I'm obsessed with ballet, Ao.

records.jp: 愛央も大概だよね
records.en_original: But you're the same way.
records.en: But you're the same way.

records.jp: いいじゃーん！<CR>愛が大きいことはいいことだよ！
records.en_original: What's wrong with that?! There's no such thing as too much love!
records.en: What's wrong with that?! There's no such thing as too much love!

records.jp: ……まぁ、それもそうだね
records.en_original: Yeah, I guess you're right.
records.en: Yeah, I guess you're right.

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
